remark: BLM page states no season (fees, sites, stay limit only); rec.gov facility 251835 text has no season either. Facility 251835 is 'Upper Onion Creek Group Site' (group sites A and B only), so the chip's 02-10..11-30 is the group sites' reservation calendar, not the 14 individual sites' open season. Also checked the Moab Field Office page and its Colorado River daily campsites PDF (map, no dates). Booking: BLM says the 14 individual sites are first-come only and only the two group sites are reservable, so booking.reservable=true / fcfs=some_sites describes the group sites, not the RV sites.
